newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes easier but off day's low in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes easier but off day's low in Hong Kong.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed easier on Wednesday but off the day's low in quiet and narrow trading following a lower close in New York overnight, dealers said.
"We saw light selling from overseas investors," a local trading house dealer said.
Bullion hit a low of US$340.50/341.00 an ounce before closing at $340.60/341.10 against New York's $341.10/60 close on Tuesday and Hong Kong's previous close of $342.00/50.

"There's a lack of trading interest and the price of gold stayed within a 70 U.S. cent range all day," another gold dealer said. "Players were cautious in taking positions without a clear market trend and an absence of strong market-moving factors."
Local gold ended HK$11 lower at HK$3,153 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to -4.50 from its previous fix at -5.90.
